SYNTHETIC – NOT A REAL PATIENT
HPI: Mr. Kendall Pretend is a 66-year-old male. Low back pain began on 07/19/2026. He denies trauma. History of cancer. Pain that worsens when supine or at night. He denies fever, weight loss, or bowel/bladder changes.
Exam: Vital signs stable. Inspection of lumbar spine shows no deformity. Palpation reveals tenderness over paraspinal muscles without midline tenderness. Range of motion limited due to discomfort. Neurologic exam: normal lower-extremity strength, reflexes and sensation. No radiculopathy.
Assessment: Acute low back pain, likely mechanical, with red flags for malignancy given cancer history and nocturnal pain.
Plan: Continue conservative measures with activity modification, acetaminophen as needed. MRI to evaluate for spinal metastasis given cancer history. Return in one week.
